text:
morgan: Heads-up — customers hitting timeouts on /v1/rerank when candidate_count > ~500. Saw it in prod last night. anyone digging?
raj: saw a spike in p99 latency on reranker pool, looks like KV cache thrash + massive fanout to multiple model variants.
jess: are these coming from single tenant requests or many small ones?
morgan: single-tenant bursts mostly. one customer sent 1 request with 2k candidates.
sam: omg. that's gonna blow our batching assumptions. we cap batch size at 1024 tokens per shard but candidate_count multiplies work.
raj: quick data point from logs:
```
request_id=abc123 tenant=acme candidate_count=2048 model_hint="rwd-bert-large" -> fanout=3
latencies: model_a=620ms model_b=980ms model_c=410ms
```
jess: thoughts: we need both API-level throttling and a better quota accounting unit. current token-based billing doesn't reflect rerank cost.
morgan: agreed. proposal: introduce `candidate_units` that = sum_over_candidates(model_weight). e.g., default weight 1 for small models, 3 for large. bill + quota against candidate_units.
raj: +1. also we should add an input param `preferred_model` (opaque string) that is only a hint for routing; if capacity constrained we can fallback to cheaper variant. that avoids unexpected full-cost fanouts.
sam: important: `preferred_model` must not change semantics for scoring — customers assume determinism. Make fallback explicit in response envelope when we route to variant.
jess: UI/Console: show per-tenant candidate_units consumption and a histogram of candidate_count per request. Add warning for >500.
console-bot: suggested dashboard tiles: rerank.candidate_count.p50/p90/p99, rerank.candidate_units.tenant_top10, rerank.fanout.fallback_rate.
deploy-bot: canary patch queued to add soft limit 500 candidates + burst to 2k with approval.
morgan: +1 on soft limit. We need clear API behavior doc: 1) server will accept up to 2000 candidates if tenant has burst credit, 2) otherwise 429 with Retry-After, 3) response will include `routed_model` and `model_fallback` boolean.
raj: telemetry names to emit in change: `rerank.request.candidate_count`, `rerank.request.candidate_units`, `rerank.model.fanout_count`, `rerank.model.fallback`. Also emit `rerank.latency.per_model` keyed by model_variant.
sam: implementation note: in the router we can compute candidate_units before enqueuing and reject early if quota exceeded — avoids wasted work.
jess: API shape example for request and response (rough):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "...",
  "candidates": ["id1","id2",...],
  "preferred_model": "rwd-bert-large" // optional hint
}

200 OK
{
  "results": [{"id":"id1","score":0.93}, ...],
  "routed_model": "rwd-bert-medium",
  "model_fallback": true,
  "candidate_units": 2048
}
```
morgan: for quotas: add a per-tenant monthly candidate_unit quota and a realtime rate limit expressed as candidate_units/sec. keep token billing as-is but make candidate_units visible and optionally billable in enterprise contracts.
raj: rollout plan: 1) telemetry + reject path (soft 500), 2) console tile and alerts, 3) opt-in candidate_units billing for a few customers, 4) default enforcement.
jess: I'll PR console mockups. sam, can you own router changes? raj will own telemetry and billing schema. morgan will draft API doc.
sam: ack, will start on router patch. aiming for canary next week.
morgan: thanks. ping me if you need sample logs. :thumbsup:
console-bot: action_items: ["PR: console mockups by jess","Router: compute candidate_units by sam","Telemetry: emit metrics by raj","API doc: morgan"]
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: rerank-soft-limit-v1 -> staging at 2026-03-25T02:00Z
raj: one more thing — let's add a quick unit in console called "estimated_cost" per rerank that maps candidate_units -> $ to help customers.
morgan: good call. we'll include that in the mockups.
jess: cool. closing the loop here, will link PR in this thread when ready.
